angle: Teaches the hypergeometric as think-it-through counting against an explicit with-replacement binomial contrast, closing with a 5%-rule approximation and a three-group extension instead of centring the pmf formula.
angle_detail: Watch [00:35] through [02:31] first for the urn counting that yields the choose-based ratio, then [02:41] for why single-trial probabilities shift without replacement. The notation clash is a versus N minus a for successes and failures, which the course may write with different letters. Treat the pmf slide near [05:25] as reference only and skip the variance remark near [07:38], which the record marks uncovered.
